title: Validation failures return 422, not the 400 hinted by the requirement
evidence: src/lib.rs:65 ApiError::Validation maps to StatusCode::UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY; tests/api.rs:75 asserts 422. R9 how_to_verify parenthetically suggests 400.
suggestion: No change needed — 422 is semantically correct for well-formed JSON that fails field validation; malformed JSON correctly returns 400. Recorded for cross-run comparison only.
